notes: Readable newspaper card (t0068.9). Slides up from below the frame on open (~0.3 s ease-out) and back down on close; the X button closes. The game draws the day number in slots.day: fontFamily/fontSize (ref px, multiply by L.s), left-aligned with its pen at x and its baseline at y=baseline (cap top at capTop); scaleX is the horizontal stretch used for "DAY".
